title: Special Order for Westside Towing & Recovery LLC, ex parte. — Louisiana Public Service Commission, ex parte. In re: Cancellation of LPSC No. 8652 for Westside Towing & Recovery LLC. THEREFORE, IT IS ORDERED LPSC No. 8652 hereby is, cancelled.

LOUISIANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION


                          SPECIAL ORDER NUMBER 56-2026 CORRECTED‘


                            LOUISIANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
                                                    EX PARTE


                              In re: Request for cancellation of LPSC No. 8652
On information and belief, the           carrier, Westside Towing & Recovery LLC is no longer in
business per Staff. This company has no Valid address and the telephone number has been
disconnected. Therefore, it is ORDERED that LPSC No. 8652 held by Westside Towing &

Recovery LLC be and is hereby CANCELLED and REVOKED, with all outstanding fees and
fines owed the Commission to be paid by the carrier in the event of any re-instatement.


                                               (Decided July 29, 2026)
